Question: Using NHANES from 1999 to 2018  we will run a weighted Cox regression using exam weights where the predictor is uric acid levels (mg/dl) categorized as quintiles as cut-offs QN1: <20%, QN2: >=20 and <40%, QN3: >=40 and <60%, QN4: >=60 and <80%, QN5: >=80%. Outcome is all-cause mortality, time-to-event is follow up duration. Covariates include age, sex, race categorized  as non-hispanic white, non-hispanic black, mexican american or hispanic, and other. We will include participants with diabetes at baseline were defined as having been diagnosed by physicians or as having a glycated hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) value 6.5% or a fasting plasma glucose level 126 mg/dL. The patients with diabetes who had at least one of the following conditions were excluded: 1) individuals aged less than 20 years; 2) a pregnancy at baseline; 3) having cancer at baseline; 4) missing information on serum uric acid levels, estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) which requires serum creatinine (mg/dl), age, and sex, race,  and HbA1c values; and 5) for whom information on death status was unavailable.

  QN3: >=40 and <60%
  QN4: >=60 and <80%
  QN5: >=80%

Outcome:
- time-to-event: follow up duration
- event indicator: all-cause mortality

-- ========== STEP 1: Inclusion ==========

-- STEP 1.1: Includes participants with diabetes at baseline, defined by physician diagnosis OR HbA1c >= 6.5% OR fasting plasma glucose >= 126 mg/dL
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_step1 AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM final_master_table
WHERE "doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" = 'Yes'
   OR "glycohemoglobin" >= 6.5
   OR "fasting_glucose_mg_dl" >= 126;

-- ========== STEP 2: Exclusions ==========

-- STEP 2.1: Exclude individuals aged less than 20 years
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step1 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."age_in_years_at_screening" >= 20;

-- STEP 2.2: Exclude participants with a pregnancy at baseline
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step2 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."pregnancy_status_at_exam" IS NULL
   OR f."pregnancy_status_at_exam" NOT IN ('Yes, positive lab pregnancy test or self-reported pregnant at exam');

-- STEP 2.3: Exclude participants having cancer at baseline
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step3 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step2 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."ever_told_you_had_cancer_or_malignancy" IS NULL
   OR f."ever_told_you_had_cancer_or_malignancy" NOT IN ('Yes');

-- STEP 2.4: Exclude participants with missing information on serum uric acid levels
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step4 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step3 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."uric_acid_mg_dl" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.5: Exclude participants with missing information on serum creatinine (mg/dl)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step5 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step4 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."creatinine_mg_dl" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.6: Exclude participants with missing information on age
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step6 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step5 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."age_in_years_at_screening" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.7: Exclude participants with missing information on sex
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step7 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step6 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."gender" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.8: Exclude participants with missing information on race
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step8 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step7 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."race_hispanic_origin" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.9: Exclude participants with missing information on HbA1c values
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step9 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step8 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."glycohemoglobin" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step9 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."mortality_status" IS NOT NULL;

-- ========== STEP 3: Final Cohort ==========

-- The final temp table in the exclusion sequence becomes temp_cohort.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_cohort AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step10;

-- ========== STEP 4: Variables ==========

-- 4.1 Age
-- Extract age from cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_age AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."age_in_years_at_screening" AS "age"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.2 Sex
-- Extract sex from cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_sex AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."gender" AS "sex"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.3 Race
-- Map race to specified categories
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_race AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE f."race_hispanic_origin"
    WHEN 'Non-Hispanic White' THEN 'non-hispanic white'
    WHEN 'Non-Hispanic Black' THEN 'non-hispanic black'
    WHEN 'Mexican American' THEN 'mexican american or hispanic'
    WHEN 'Other Hispanic' THEN 'mexican american or hispanic'
    WHEN 'Other Race - Including Multi-Racial' THEN 'other'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "race"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.4 Uric Acid Levels (mg/dl)
-- Extract raw uric acid levels for cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_uric_acid_raw AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."uric_acid_mg_dl" AS "uric_acid_levels_mg_dl"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Compute quintile cutoffs for uric acid levels within cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_uric_acid_cutoffs AS
SELECT
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.20) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "uric_acid_levels_mg_dl") AS q1,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.40) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "uric_acid_levels_mg_dl") AS q2,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.60) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "uric_acid_levels_mg_dl") AS q3,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.80) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "uric_acid_levels_mg_dl") AS q4
FROM temp_uric_acid_raw;

-- Assign uric acid levels to quintile groups
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_uric_acid_quintiles AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN "uric_acid_levels_mg_dl" IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN "uric_acid_levels_mg_dl" < (SELECT q1 FROM temp_uric_acid_cutoffs) THEN 'QN1: <20%'
    WHEN "uric_acid_levels_mg_dl" < (SELECT q2 FROM temp_uric_acid_cutoffs) THEN 'QN2: >=20 and <40%'
    WHEN "uric_acid_levels_mg_dl" < (SELECT q3 FROM temp_uric_acid_cutoffs) THEN 'QN3: >=40 and <60%'
    WHEN "uric_acid_levels_mg_dl" < (SELECT q4 FROM temp_uric_acid_cutoffs) THEN 'QN4: >=60 and <80%'
    ELSE 'QN5: >=80%'
  END AS "uric_acid_levels_mg_dl"
FROM temp_uric_acid_raw;

-- 4.5 Follow Up Duration
-- Extract follow up duration from cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_follow_up_duration AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."months_followup_examination" AS "follow_up_duration"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.6 All-Cause Mortality
-- Extract all-cause mortality status from cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_all_cause_mortality AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."mortality_status" AS "all_cause_mortality"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- ========== STEP 5: Final Table ==========
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_final_table AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  age_tbl."age",
  sex_tbl."sex",
  race_tbl."race",
  ua_tbl."uric_acid_levels_mg_dl",
  fud_tbl."follow_up_duration",
  acm_tbl."all_cause_mortality"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN temp_age age_tbl ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = age_tbl."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_sex sex_tbl ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = sex_tbl."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_race race_tbl ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = race_tbl."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_uric_acid_quintiles ua_tbl ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = ua_tbl."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_follow_up_duration fud_tbl ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = fud_tbl."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_all_cause_mortality acm_tbl ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = acm_tbl."respondent_sequence_number";
